dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, this is my brother and his wife.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ðɪs ɪz maɪ ˈbrʌðər ənd hɪz ˈwaɪf.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh! And this baby? Your nephew?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ! ənd ðɪs ˈbeɪbi? jʊr ˈnɛfjuː?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, my niece! She's their daughter.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, maɪ ˈniːs! ʃiːz ðɛr ˈdɔːtər.
